cases.input: Issuer X has 100 Class A units at 1 vote/unit and 100 Class B units at 10 votes/unit. H owns 51 A units and no B.
cases.expect: H economic share by units is 25.5% of 200 units and vote share is 51/1100 = 4.636%; neither is stored as a holding.

cases.input: X owns 40 of 100 Y-A units and Y owns 30 of 100 X-A units under proportional-look-through v1, tolerance 0.0001 and maxIterations 100.
cases.expect: Separate positions remain; claim records convention, cycleSet {X,Y}, tolerance, iteration count and converged or unresolved state.

cases.input: Voting rights change after an approved class amendment.
cases.expect: A new class version becomes effective while historical positions retain the prior version.

cases.input: A 51 percent economic interest is asserted to mean 51 percent of votes.
cases.expect: The inference is rejected without a vote-weighted calculation.

cases.input: A majority holder signs a contract without an effective mandate.
cases.expect: The authority inference is rejected.

cases.input: Meeting attendance is used to establish board appointment and voting eligibility.
cases.expect: Both inferences are rejected.

cases.input: A resolution adopted without quorum is silently marked valid.
cases.expect: The transition is rejected and the defective record is preserved.

cases.input: One ownership link and one contractual-control link connect the same organizations.
cases.expect: They remain distinct typed WM-ORG-012 profile instances with independent basis, scope and periods.

cases.input: A holding spans a Share Class voting-rights amendment.
cases.expect: Calculations before and after the amendment use their respective pinned class versions.

cases.input: Two results within one scenario use different reciprocal-holding cycle conventions.
cases.expect: The comparison and aggregation are rejected as incomparable.

cases.input: An indirect voting percentage omits knowledge time, class version or denominator rule.
cases.expect: The calculated claim is non-authoritative.

cases.input: An Ownership Interest stores controls=true because the economic percentage exceeds 50 percent.
cases.expect: The field and inference are rejected.

cases.input: A voting majority is automatically added to the consolidation perimeter.
cases.expect: The inference is rejected without a named consolidation rule, time and scenario.

cases.input: A director membership ends after attendance at an earlier meeting.
cases.expect: The membership interval closes while historical attendance and body identity remain unchanged.

cases.input: A meeting procedure defines quorum by eligible votes with recusals excluded.
cases.expect: The determination records denominator, exclusions, recusals and instant separately from attendance.

cases.input: Decision content and authentic expression exist but no WM-ACT-025 procedure evidence is attached.
cases.expect: The Resolution composition is incomplete and cannot be treated as validly adopted.

cases.input: A no-quorum Resolution is used to create a Mandate or signing power.
cases.expect: The authority effect is rejected while the defective record remains readable.

cases.input: WM-ORG-007 Mandate is used to own meeting quorum and member eligibility.
cases.expect: Reuse is blocked because mandate, eligibility and quorum must remain distinct.

cases.input: A Resolution directly changes a WM-ECO-038 holding quantity.
cases.expect: The mutation is rejected; execution requires the appropriate corporate-action or transaction boundary.

cases.input: A consumer assigns or infers a WM identifier for Share Class, or publishes canonically, while allocationState is unassigned.
cases.expect: Both are rejected; the candidate stays identifier-unassigned and non-publishable.

cases.input: A class transitions to amended instead of appending a version.
cases.expect: Rejected; the class stays active and a new ShareClassVersion appends.

cases.input: A version reaches effective without Mandate, decision, authentic record and procedure-evidence pins.
cases.expect: Rejected; all four authorityBundle refs are required.

cases.input: Issuer X reuses designation A after old class A closed, with non-overlapping intervals.
cases.expect: Two distinct shareClassIds; temporal uniqueness holds and designation is not identity.

cases.input: A pin digest differs from the stored canonical version digest.
cases.expect: Every resolving calculation is non-reproducible and non-authoritative.

cases.input: A rights schedule is corrected retroactively after a claim was published.
cases.expect: A new version with new recordedAt appends; original claim replays against its old pin.

cases.input: A version becomes effective without denominatorPolicyRef or issuedQuantityRule.
cases.expect: Rejected.

cases.input: At T, issued=1000, treasury=100, suspended=50.
cases.expect: Outstanding denominator is 850 and treasury casts zero votes.

cases.input: An indirect voting claim includes every derivedClaimContract field and converges.
cases.expect: It persists as a derived claim, never a holding or relationship.

cases.input: For each required derivedClaimContract field, one claim omits exactly that field.
cases.expect: Every omission independently makes the claim non-authoritative.

cases.input: An iterative cycle fails tolerance by maxIterations.
cases.expect: Status is unresolved; no authoritative number is published; cycleSet and iteration evidence remain.

cases.input: A reciprocal cycle converges under scc-collapse v1.
cases.expect: Claim records cycleSet, convention identity, tolerance, maxIterations and actual iterations.

cases.input: Two calculations share a scenario label but have different unresolved scenario identities.
cases.expect: Comparison and aggregation are rejected.

cases.input: A filing asserts 30% while a pinned walk derives 28.7%.
cases.expect: Both claims persist in distinct categories and discrepancy remains visible.

cases.input: Person P holds 25 units of X-A.
cases.expect: WM-ECO-038 carries the position; no WM-ORG-012 inter-organizational link is fabricated.

cases.input: Nominee registered holding and beneficial interest over the same units are summed.
cases.expect: Rejected without an explicit cross-capacity aggregation rule.

cases.input: WM-ORG-012 ownership facet duplicates WM-ECO-038 quantity or percentage.
cases.expect: Rejected; position exclusively masters quantity and class pin.

cases.input: Two memberships are open on the same body and seat at one instant.
cases.expect: Rejected.

cases.input: Appointment extends outside body existence or authority validity.
cases.expect: Rejected.

cases.input: Member resigns mid-term.
cases.expect: Cessation with reason is recorded separately from termEnd; history is unchanged.

cases.input: A charter is replaced, then a body is later dissolved and replaced.
cases.expect: Charter replacement preserves identity; dissolution creates a successor body with link.

cases.input: One meeting decides two items with different recusals.
cases.expect: Eligibility, quorum denominator, exclusions and outcome are recorded per item.

cases.input: A decision is taken by written consent with no meeting.
cases.expect: Consent threshold and each consent authority are recorded; no attendance or quorum is asserted.

cases.input: A Mandate and contract cite one Resolution.
cases.expect: Both resolve to the same WM-REC-010 anchor carrying content, evidence and status refs.

cases.input: A later valid Resolution ratifies an earlier no-quorum Resolution.
cases.expect: A new valid anchor records ratification; defective anchor stays not-validly-adopted.

cases.input: WM-ORG-007 records all nine mandate elements and excludes eligibility and quorum.
cases.expect: Gate passes; omission blocks reuse and raises only an unassigned Mandate candidate.

cases.input: Mandate is revoked retroactively after signature.
cases.expect: Authority is re-evaluated at act valid and knowledge times; prior claim is superseded, not erased.

cases.input: Class conversion moves positions within Share Class or Resolution.
cases.expect: Rejected and held until Corporate Action / Transaction Execution is assigned.
